Moonlight Hostel & PG - Premium Boys' Hostel in Lohegaon, Pune

Welcome to Moonlight Hostel & PG, the premier student housing and coliving destination for male students in Lohegaon, Pune. Our brand new facility is engineered to provide the perfect blend of a high-focus study environment, secure living, and modern comfort for students near D.Y. Patil University campus. We aim to offer a "home away from home" experience that takes care of all daily operations so you can focus purely on your college curriculum, engineering projects, and career goals.

A Premium Coliving Standard and Vibrant Community

Moonlight Hostel is managed with a core focus on student success. Founded in 2026, our brand new building offers college students a clean, modern sanctuary. We deliberately limit our total capacity to just 50 students. This cap ensures that our common dining hall, study lounges, and sports areas are never overcrowded. A cozy layout helps build a supportive community of like-minded young minds pursuing their dreams in Pune. Housekeeping, cleaning, and laundry are completely handled by our in-house staff, eliminating everyday stress from your student life.

Fully-Equipped and Managed Amenities

Our coliving model is built for complete hassle-free living. Every single floor is covered by high-speed fiber Wi-Fi networks to assist with online classes, exam preparation, and software development. In the event of a power cut, our heavy-duty diesel generator (DG) backup system immediately restores full electricity to every bedroom, study desk, and washroom geyser. We provide professional daily housekeeping where our team sweeps, mops, and dusts every room. Additionally, our free in-house laundry service cleans, dries, and folds your clothes multiple times a week, ensuring you always look sharp without wasting valuable study hours.

Individual 1:1 Study Desks & Productivity Setup

Unlike standard cramped student hostels, we prioritize your academic focus. Every resident student gets their own private, spacious wooden study workstation and comfortable high-back chair. This setup includes personal reading lights, dedicated power sockets for laptops and phone chargers, and overhead book storage. The hostel maintains strict silent hours in common areas during exam periods, allowing you to study in peace. We maintain a strict 1:1 student-to-desk ratio so that you never have to share workspace or worry about finding a place to learn.

Hygienic Home-Style Dining Routine

Healthy nutrition is vital for active minds. Our on-site kitchen serves fresh, nutritious meals designed to replicate the comfort of home dining. We provide a daily breakfast and dinner schedule on weekdays. On weekends, we cover all three meals, including Saturday lunch and a premium, relaxed Sunday brunch session. Our menus are carefully planned to include a balance of fresh vegetables, high-protein options, and local flavors. Clean drinking water is continuously provided through high-stage RO purification plants located on every floor.

Uncompromising 24/7 Security Protocols

We take student safety extremely seriously. Access to the Moonlight Hostel building is strictly controlled via biometric fingerprint verification scanners and keycard reader gates. Corridors, lobbies, staircases, and entrance points are monitored continuously by high-resolution CCTV surveillance cameras. A professional, resident warden resides on-site full-time to enforce safety regulations, guide students, and manage any emergency. The building is fully compliant with local fire safety standards, featuring fire extinguishers, smoke detectors, and emergency exits.

Premium Room Options and Yearly Value Packages

Students can choose from two double-sharing configurations designed for modern comfort. Our Balcony Double Sharing Room offers an attached private balcony with custom sliding glass doors, dual lockable wardrobe cabinets, side-by-side study tables, and a modern western attached washroom with a heavy-duty geyser. The Standard Double Sharing Room provides a compact, optimized design featuring custom wooden beds, dedicated storage cupboards, and access to common balconies on each floor. Both options are priced as an all-inclusive yearly package covering rent, food, laundry, Wi-Fi, and utilities, with no hidden maintenance fees.

Prime Location near D.Y. Patil University

We are situated in Sai Samruddhi Park, Nimbalkar Nagar, Lane No. 6, D.Y. Patil University Road, Lohegaon, Pune - 411047. The hostel is located just 1.2 km from the campus, which is a 3-minute ride or a 12-minute walk. The local Lohegaon neighborhood is quiet and peaceful, yet keeps you close to local cafes, food courts, stationery shops, and transport networks. An optional shuttle transit service is available for daily commute support.
